department: Department of Women & Child Development (WCD), GNCTD

name.en: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana (DLY / Mahila Samriddhi Yojana — ₹2,500/month)

bilingual_title.en: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana (DLY / Mahila Samriddhi Yojana — ₹2,500/month)

eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Applicant, husband, or parent resident of Delhi (NCT) >=10 years + applicant is registered Delhi voter; Gurugram/Faridabad/Noida/Ghaziabad excluded.
eligibility_criteria.income_cap: Family annual income <= ₹2,50,000; prior 12-month family electricity <= 2,400 units
eligibility_criteria.category_rules: Female aged 21–60 yrs, eldest woman in family (1 beneficiary per family), <=3 children.
eligibility_criteria.academic_or_work_rules: CBDC-enabled active bank account + signed MP/MLA endorsement per rules.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Govt/PSU/local-body employee in family, 4-wheeler owner in family, IT/GST filer, recipient of other govt pension, public office holder or criminal record.

benefit.summary_hi: पात्र दिल्ली परिवार की सबसे बड़ी महिला सदस्य को प्रति माह ₹2,500 की सीधी वित्तीय सहायता।
benefit.summary_en: ₹2,500/month direct financial assistance for eligible eldest woman in qualifying Delhi households.
